text:
kai: Heads-up: after I applied the RBAC tighten for secrets-writer in ns=priv, we saw unexpected outbound KMS traffic to 45.77.1.23. Not in allowlist. Anyone oncall?

ops-bot: [ALERT] priv-cluster egress anomaly detected 2026-05-10T14:22Z. 32 connections to 45.77.1.23 from serviceAccount:secrets-writer.

anita: Oncall. Paste the exact kubectl patch and which pods use that SA. Also run `kubectl get rolebinding -n priv -o yaml | grep -C2 secrets-writer`.

kai: Patch was: `kubectl patch rolebinding priv-secrets-writer -n priv --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/roleRef/name","value":"secrets-reader"}]'` at 14:21:05Z. Pods: secrets-writer-0, secrets-writer-1.

dinesh: VPC logs show NAT-gw-2 outbound at 14:21:07Z. Suggest containment: rotate the SA token, patch deployment to ephemeral no-egress SA, and apply VPC deny for 45.77.1.23.

clare: I'll prepare an RBAC rollback snippet and add a quick smoke egress probe to the change runbook. We should gate any secrets-role change with that probe going forward.

maria: I'll open vuln-triage ticket and collect kube-apiserver audit, node journal, and egress-proxy traces. If KMS host is external, loop in legal/compliance.

kai: Running minimal containment now: created sa temp-noegress, patched deployment to use it, and restarted pods. Applied VPC-level deny for 45.77.1.23.

forensics-bot: Collected artifacts: pod env (/var/run/secrets) snapshot, kube-audit lines, and flow logs. Uploaded to INC-2026-502.

anita: From audit snippet there are repeated GET /v1/decrypt calls from the SA token immediately after the RBAC change. No impersonate entries. Looks like app retried cached requests once permission changed.

dinesh: Run `trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL` against the container image to check for embedded creds. Also preserve node disk for deeper forensic if needed.

clare: Short-term actions for postmortem: 1) add preflight egress smoke test for RBAC changes that touch secrets/KMS roles 2) enforce short-lived SA tokens and automated rotation 3) add alert for KMS host hits from private clusters 4) update runbook with rollback + telemetry checks.

maria: I'll own the vuln-triage and customer/legal notification if we confirm external key usage.

kai: Thanks everyone. I'll add timeline and artifacts to INC-2026-502 and schedule a follow-up postmortem.
